name: Feast at the Blue Recluse
summary: In Dustwallow Marsh, you finish your work for Morgan Stern with ... and Bugs, then return to Angus Stern at the Blue Recluse.

sections.title: Back to the Blue Recluse
sections.body: Angus Stern is Morgan Stern's uncle. You return to Angus at the Blue Recluse after helping Morgan research recipes in Dustwallow Marsh.

sections.title: What Angus Has Heard
sections.body: Angus has heard from Morgan that you aided his research and helped one of his associates out of a tight spot. The Sterns look after their friends, and a party in your honor is about to begin.

faq.answer: Angus Stern is Morgan Stern's uncle and is connected to the Blue Recluse.

faq.q: How is Angus Stern connected to Morgan Stern?
faq.answer: Angus is Morgan's uncle. He sent Morgan to Theramore to gather recipes for the Blue Recluse's new bayou-themed menu.
It follows ... and Bugs, the last of your work for Morgan Stern in Theramore.
